aula.text: **Móveis e aparelhos:** wardrobe (guarda-roupa), shelf (prateleira), sofa (sofá), fridge (geladeira), dishwasher (lava-louças), washing machine (máquina de lavar), oven (forno), curtains (cortinas), carpet (carpete).

items: "I live in a house of two floors." O certo é **a two-storey house.**
"My flat has a beautiful vision of the sea." *Vision* é visão no sentido de enxergar. O certo é **view.**

lessons.title: Second conditional
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Second conditional (if + past simple, would + infinitivo); If I were you; first x second.

head: Estrutura
Uso
Exemplo
rows: If I had more money, I'd buy a house by the sea.
If I were you, I'd talk to the landlord.
If I win the lottery, I'll travel. If I won the lottery, I'd travel.

items: Depois de *if* use o past simple, mas o sentido é presente ou futuro.
Com *be*, o formal é **were** para todas as pessoas: *If I were you.*
Nunca use *would* logo depois de if.
"If I would have more time, I would travel more." O certo é **If I had more time, I would travel more.**
"If I won the lottery, I will buy a farm." O certo é **I would buy a farm.**

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (have) more money, I ___ (buy) a bigger flat.
If I ___ (be) you, I ___ (talk) to the landlord.
What ___ you ___ (do) if you ___ (win) the lottery?

If I had more time, I'd travel more

exercises.prompt: If I won the lottery, I will buy a farm.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, reclamar e resolver problemas
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Reclamar e resolver problemas.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'm afraid there's a problem with... / The ... isn't working. / There's a leak in...
I'm sorry to bother you, but... / I'd like to make a complaint.
Could you send someone to fix it? / Could you do something about it?
I'm so sorry about that. / I'll look into it right away. / We'll send someone tomorrow.
That would be great. Thank you for your help.

items: "The air conditioning is broken since yesterday." O certo é **has been broken since yesterday.**
"There are many noises from the flat upstairs." *Noise* com esse sentido é incontável. O certo é **There is a lot of noise.**
